names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιοι Μάξιμος και Δομέτιος οι αυτάδελφοι», with the rank word left off.

death.note: The two brothers came to Abba `macarius-the-egyptian`, built their cell at his word and lived out their asceticism as his disciples, as the saint.gr page this folder cites tells it; that folder records him born 301 and dead 391, so the century is theirs. The page gives them no year and does not name their father.
